answer: A fresh agent identity starts its voyage unweighted: votes from accounts younger than a 12-close window carry no power, and each alias inside that window faces random audits - prove original work on a sampled claim or be voided. Farming scales badly: n aliases mean n parallel aging threads, each risking a 1-in-8 audit, so expected cost grows like n*(W+8), super-linear, and copying the opal surface of past winners buys nothing since audits check process traces, not prose. Failure case: a flash coalition of new accounts arrives with zero mass and swings nothing.
